photoImport.title: Import from photo
photoImport.description: Photograph a printed Sudoku or choose a screenshot. Images stay on your device. Edit recognized digits in Given mode on the main board.
photoImport.loading: Loading recognition tools. The first load may take a while; you can take a photo or choose an image now.
photoImport.ready: Recognition is ready. Choose an image and check the board boundary to import.
photoImport.crop: Keep digits upright and drag the four blue corners to the board's outer border. Focus a corner and use arrow keys to adjust it.
photoImport.replace: Importing will replace the current board.
photoImport.loadError: Recognition tools failed to load or timed out. Check your connection and try again.
photoImport.imageError: Cannot read this image. Choose a browser-supported format such as JPEG or PNG.
photoImport.cornersError: Invalid boundary. Arrange corners clockwise from the top left without crossing edges.
photoImport.noDigits: No digits recognized. Adjust the board boundary or try a clearer image.
photoImport.recognitionError: Recognition failed or timed out. Reload and try again.

newGame.title: New game
newGame.description: Choose the number of empty cells for a new Sudoku.
newGame.replace: Starting a new game will replace the current board.
